info.description: One Walker agent in a 100x100 continuous space, placed at [0, 0] and sent moving to [80, 0] the instant it starts (an entry action on its initial state); it enters Arrived on the 'arrived' message move_to delivers on the exact arrival instant. A straight trip at a fixed speed is a deterministic oracle: sojourn in Moving equals distance/speed exactly, no tolerance needed. Copy this asset, add more agents with a random {"kind": "random"} placement and a move_to target expression (e.g. another agent's position via AGENT(...)) to build a crowd or a pursuit model.
